newsitem.title: USA: UroMed to cut 32 employees in restructuring.
newsitem.headline: UroMed to cut 32 employees in restructuring.

text.p: UroMed Corp said on Monday that 32 employees of its 188-person work force would be laid off as part of an initiative to reduce operating costs and to focus resources on a series of new products.

Noting that market acceptance for the company's Reliance Urinary Control Insert had been slower than expected, chief executive John Simon said domestic revenue growth "had not been meaningful to date."

He added, "We are taking the appropriate steps necessary to realign the company's resources to better reflect the slow ramp up for Reliance and the promising market for our other solutions for treating female urinary incontinence."
UroMed develops male and female healthcare products, with an initial focus on an integrated system of continence care.
